entity.title: DeploymentState
entity.description: The record of what template versions are deployed to which repositories.

rules.body: IS the record of what template versions are deployed to which repositories.
MUST be stored as JSON at `.steerspec/deployment-state.json` in the central repository.
HAS per-repository records containing: deployed version, timestamp, PR number, and PR status.
MUST be updated after each SyncOperation that is not a dry run.
HAS a Blake3 hash for integrity verification.
For a template using the marker strategy, a per-repository record HAS the names of the sections the template manages and the Blake3 hash of those sections in the deployed file.
